cookies.message: We use cookies to improve your experience on this site.

home.heroSubtitle: Clothing and accessories built to last, shaped to leave a mark.
home.promoBody: Use this code at checkout. Valid until the end of the month.
home.editorialBody: Every Reign piece starts with a choice: the fabric, the cut, the detail you don't see but always feel.

product.detailsBody: Materials chosen for their structure and longevity, reinforced seams and finishes checked one by one. Every piece is built to hold its shape season after season.
product.careBody: Favour gentle care: low-temperature washing or the cleaning method suited to the material, then air dry. Store your pieces away from direct light to preserve their colour.

items.question: What are the delivery times?
items.answer: Allow 2 to 4 business days in France, 4 to 7 business days for the UK.

items.question: Can I return an item?
items.answer: Yes, within 30 days of receipt, unworn and in its original packaging. See our Shipping & Returns page for details.

items.question: How do I know my size?
items.answer: Check our size guide, accessible from every product page and from the footer.

items.question: Do you ship internationally?
items.answer: We currently ship to France and the UK. More countries will follow.

items.question: How do I track my order?
items.answer: A confirmation email is sent after your order, including your order number.

about.title: About Reign
about.paragraph1: Reign was built on a simple conviction: clothing should hold its shape, literally and figuratively. Every collection starts from a silhouette, not a trend.
about.paragraph2: We work with a deliberately small number of materials and suppliers, to keep full control over the cut, construction, and finish of every piece.
about.paragraph3: Men, women, kids, accessories: one standard runs through every category — every piece is built to last, and built to command attention.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: A question about an order, a collection, or a partnership? Write to us.

errors.tooShort: Your message is too short (minimum 10 characters).

contact.success: Thank you, your message has been sent. We'll get back to you shortly.

shippingReturns.title: Shipping & Returns
shippingReturns.shippingBody: Orders ship within 24 to 48 business hours. Estimated delivery: 2 to 4 business days in France, 4 to 7 business days for the UK.
shippingReturns.returnsBody: Returns are accepted within 30 days of receipt, unworn and in original packaging.
shippingReturns.exchangesBody: For a size or color exchange, return the item and place a new order — your refund is triggered as soon as the return is received.
